{{Status infobox
|Lift
|Applies {{G|Vulnerable}} on an enemy. If the enemy is already {{G|Vulnerable}}, then add 1 stack of {{G|Vulnerable}}, and deal {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} and {{Color|Stagger|2}}.

}}

{{Icon|Lift icon|'''Lift'''}} is a type of debuff, crowd control, and damage instance applied to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator applies Lift to an enemy that is not currently {{G|Vulnerable}}, a stack of Vulnerability is applied instead. Otherwise, it deals {{Color|120% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator, applies {{Color|10|8}} Stagger, and applies a stack of Vulnerability.

Weaker enemies are briefly '''Lifted''' into the air and are unable to act for {{Color|1|1d}} second. Some operators such as {{Icon|Chen Qianyu icon|[[Chen Qianyu]]}} are able to lift the enemy for a longer duration. Stronger enemies are immune to the crowd control effect but will continue to receive the additional damage, stagger and Vulnerability debuff.

Lift can be <u>forcibly applied</u> by some operators without requiring the enemy to be Vulnerable.

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b>
** {{Tooltip/Forcibly apply|Physical|Forcibly applied}} {{G|Lift}} added.
*** When an operator {{Tooltip/Forcibly apply|Physical|forcibly applies}} {{G|Lift|Lifted}}, the enemy is not required to be {{G|Vulnerable}} for the effects to be applied.
*** 
** {{G|Lift}} changed.
*** <b>New:</b> When an operator applies {{G|Lift|Lifted}} to a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, deal additional {{Color|Physical DMG|2}}, apply {{Color|Stagger|8}}, and add one more stack of {{G|Vulnerable|Vulnerability}} (up to 4 times).
*** <b>Old:</b> When an operator applies {{G|Lift|Lifted}} to a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the debuff to deal additional {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} and apply {{Color|Stagger|8}}.
* <b>Beta Test I</b>
** {{G|Lift}} added.
*** When an operator applies {{G|Lift|Lifted}} to a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the debuff to deal additional {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} and apply {{Color|Stagger|8}}.
*** When an operator applies {{G|Lift|Lifted}} to a non-{{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, apply {{G|Vulnerable}} instead.
}}
